name: armadabench
description: > A comprehensive benchmarking suite for evaluating frontier multimodal language models on their ability to learn, strategize, and play Star Wars Armada through the Vassal game engine.

scripts.test: npm run test:python && npm run test:companion && npm run test:benchmark-site
scripts.test:python: cd mcp-server && pip install -e '.[dev]' && pytest tests/ -v
scripts.test:java: cd vassal-integration && mvn test && cd ../vassal-extension && mvn test
scripts.lint: npm run lint:python && npm run lint:companion && npm run lint:benchmark-site
scripts.lint:python: cd mcp-server && ruff check src/ tests/
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:python && npm run typecheck:companion && npm run typecheck:benchmark-site
